title: Optional "Ephemeral Protocol" mutator toggle (`[KeyM]` or pre-match toggle): each contender may only maintain at most 3 active sigils on the lattice at once—when a contender inscribes their 4th sigil, their oldest sigil on the lattice dissolves back into a vacant sector, making Equilibrium Deadlocks impossible!
author_role: Lead Gameplay & Kinematics Specialist (State machines, physics integration, collision rules)
summary: Implement Ephemeral Protocol FIFO queue logic enforcing a maximum of 3 concurrent active sigils per contender.
technical_specification: Toggle `state.stats.ephemeralProtocol` boolean on `state.keys['KeyM']` edge trigger during pre-match or match. Track contender placements as FIFO queues: `state.stats.p1Queue` (Blade) and `state.stats.p2Queue` (Ring), storing sector indices `0..8`. When contender pushes their 4th placement index `s`, `evictedSector = queue.shift()` executes immediately before placement. Set matrix cell `state.world.matrix[evictedSector] = 0` (vacant), clear its age, and emit `EPHEMERAL_EVICT` with `{ sector: evictedSector, faction }`. Recalculate cell ages (`1..3`) for remaining elements. Deadlock evaluation is bypassed when `ephemeralProtocol` is true.
acceptance_criteria: Placing a 4th faction sigil dissolves the oldest sector to 0, ensuring maximum 3 sigils per faction.
Equilibrium Deadlock state is never triggered while ephemeralProtocol is active.
KeyM cleanly toggles protocol flag without clearing mid-match boards unless reset.
